module.name: SARG — Substrate-Agnostic Resonance Grammar
module.purpose: A minimal grammar for describing structure, resonance, and invariants across any substrate — substrate-agnostic by design, applicable to linguistic, acoustic, geometric, biological, symbolic, and cosmological domains.
